law: Shared U,V independent continuous uniforms; digital raw words are their q32 cell indexes, followed by the original exact f40 midpoint/native graph
coupling_method: One shared-uniform midpoint coupling, two fixed radial cutoffs

radial_grid.proof: For U<1/2, u*sqrt(-2log u) increases on [delta,1/2+h], giving h/(delta*r(delta)). For U>=1/2, |log U-log midpoint|<=h/(1/2-h); square-root Holder continuity gives sqrt(2h/(1/2-h)). Delta is a q32 cell boundary, so U>=delta implies midpoint>=delta+h.

candidates.zero_term_proof: q32 midpoint raw=(2k+1)*128 is exact in f40. Since midpoint<1, logarithm normalization is a left shift with exponent in [-33,-1]; no mantissa bits are discarded. Integer exponent times f40 ln2, multiplication by -2, and the .75 angular turn/wrap are exact integer operations. Square-root positive clipping is 1-Lipschitz and included in the Holder bound. A native sqrt and final product floor are each charged one f40 ulp.
candidates.independence_claim: Continuous Box-Muller outputs are independent normals; finite digital outputs remain one joint shared-input pair.
